project.title: Airborne microbiome profiling in calf housing environment using a nanopore based workflow
project.description: 16s rRNA sequencing and metagenomics sequencing using Oxford nanopore technologies on air samples collected from a calf shed environment. It was collected every week during a 6 week period (n =6 air samples). The Library preparation used was 16S Rapid Barcoding Kit (SQK-16S114.24) and Rapid Sequencing DNA Barcoding Kit (SQK-RBK114.24) and sequenced on a standard flow cell within the MinION Mk1D sequencer.
